03 — Case study

IRIS: one scent, one colour, one shelf

Three candles, three colours, one calm system.

A votive candle range needed to feel like home at a glance. We tied each fragrance to a single warm hue (mandarin, lemongrass, damask rose), then carried that colour story from the label to the moodboard to the hero poster.
